description: Read the going rate, what campaigns on Starcovery pay each creator, as the web app's Going Rate view shows it: campaigns, each with its name, compensationCents, and a stable key, highest pay first, and typicalCents, the median pay rounded to whole dollars, or null with fewer than 3 campaigns. A campaign is listed once it has a funding request, the pay release delay of its market information has passed since that funding cycle's first request, and any embargo has ended. Needs a credential.
name: get_going_rate
title: Get going rate
